title: AgentCC Gateway Admin Contract
description: Canonical backend-to-gateway admin API payload types.

Step.description: Agent step. Drives step-aware auto routing.

ContentMode.description: How much request content is kept. The most restrictive of org, key, request and global default wins.

ProviderMaxPrice.description: prompt and completion are USD per million tokens; request and image are USD per unit.

ToolCallGuardrailConfig.description: Guardrails on agent tool calls. checks names guardrail checks the org already configures.

AutoSelectorConfig.description: Optional LLM selector for ambiguous auto decisions. observe records its choice without acting on it.

AgentsEnvelopeDefaults.description: Default run envelope limits. An unset limit is unbounded.

AgentsEnvelopeLoop.description: Loop guard. action defaults to stop.

AgentsEnvelopesConfig.description: Run-tree envelopes. Defaults: on_breach stop, soft_threshold 0.8, allow_downgrade false.

RolloutRoutingConfig.description: The candidate routing of a staged rollout: RoutingConfig without rollout. Keep the properties in step with RoutingConfig.

RolloutConfig.description: Staged rollout of a candidate policy. The gateway buckets traffic deterministically by sticky_by.

throttle_rpm.description: With action throttle: past the limit, the level admits this many requests a minute (default 1) and refuses the rest with 429 budget_throttled and Retry-After; under the limit it admits every request.
The org budget's throttle (org_limit with action throttle): past the limit, this many requests a minute (default 1); the rest get 429 budget_throttled and Retry-After.

fail_mode.description: Budget holds when budget state is unreachable: closed (default) refuses with 503 budget_state_unavailable, open lets the request through unenforced.

no_max_tokens.description: A request with no max_tokens: reserve_default (default) holds the estimate and records any overshoot, clamp forwards max_tokens equal to the estimate's output cap.

cooldown.description: A Go duration (e.g. 15m). After the rule fires it waits this long before it can fire again, while its condition holds. Empty or not a duration: 15m. 0s fires on every request past the threshold.

severity.description: Sent with every alert the rule fires (webhook payload severity, Slack text). Empty: warning.

PrivacyRetentionConfig.description: Retention TTLs for request logs and attempts, at most 36500 days (100 years), so the daily purge cutoff never underflows. Ledger entries are never purged. store_bodies=false is read as content_mode=metadata.

MCPCredentialMode.description: How a server's upstream credential is resolved: none, the org's shared credential, the caller's own (per_user), RFC 8693 token exchange or ID-JAG, or a vendor's per-end-user identity (vendor_end_user).

MCPCredentialState.description: A credential's state. When a credential lapses, it keeps its mode and its state is marked.

MCPCredentialSecret.description: PUSH-ONLY. A static upstream secret assembled at push time by config_push. It is never stored in an org config, returned by a GET or kept in config history.

MCPIdentityBinding.description: Where a vendor_end_user server receives the end user's identity.

MCPServerCredential.description: The server's upstream credential. mode defaults to none and state to active.

MCPServerOAuthConfig.description: Upstream OAuth adapter. adapter defaults to auto.

MCPToolLabel.description: Information-flow label of a server or tool.

MCPServerOrgConfig.description: One upstream MCP server, keyed by a server id matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. Defaults: era auto, trusted_annotations false, timeout_ms 30000, tools_cache_ttl_seconds 300, propagate_depth false, enabled true. There is no private_network key: private egress is the operator list mcp.egress.private_allow.

transport.description: http, or sse for a 2024-11-05 upstream.

tools_cache_ttl.description: Legacy duration string (for example 5m). tools_cache_ttl_seconds wins when both are set.

forward_headers.description: Request headers forwarded upstream. authorization, cookie, x-api-key, proxy-authorization, mcp-session-id, mcp-protocol-version, x-agentcc-* and x-omega-* are refused (400 forward_header_refused), compared trimmed and case-folded; every name is an HTTP token.

MCPAccessConfig.description: What a key bound to no virtual server, with no org default, may use. default defaults to deny.

MCPVirtualServerAccess.description: Who may use the virtual server. At most one virtual server per org sets default_for_org.

MCPApprovalConfig.description: Approval settings. Defaults: require none, validity once, ttl_seconds 900. validity step ties an approval to the run, step and turn.

MCPVirtualServerConfig.description: A virtual server, keyed by a slug matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$. Defaults: naming prefixed, mode direct, cache_scope private.

id.description: vs_<ULID>. Assigned by the control plane when the slug is created and never changed (400 vs_id_immutable).

members.description: Each member is a server id, fagi.<managed_id>, or <server_id>@<account_label>.

MCPManagedToolCredential.description: The org's own credential for a fagi.* managed server. Its presence means the org has had a credential, so a lapsed one never moves calls to managed unless fallback_to_managed is set.

MCPManagedToolsConfig.description: The org's one managed opt-in for FutureAGI-supplied paid tools, MCP and REST capabilities alike. allow and deny take fagi.<id>/<tool> and <capability>/<vendor> globs. Defaults: enabled false, max_call_cost_usd unset, fallback_to_managed false, allow_user_tokens false.

MCPPinningConfig.description: Tool pinning. Defaults: mode quarantine, new_tools quarantine, auto_baseline true. pins maps <server_id>/<tool> to the sha256 of the tool's canonical definition.

MCPScanningConfig.description: Description, argument and result scanning. Defaults: descriptions warn, shadow true.

MCPFlowControlConfig.description: Run-level information-flow control. Defaults: mode shadow, on_egress_after_taint approve.

MCPPolicyDefaultTier.description: Action per risk tier when no rule matches. Defaults: read_only allow, undeclared approve, destructive approve, destructive_prod deny.

MCPShapingConfig.description: Tool result shaping. budget_bytes may not exceed the operator's mcp.max_result_bytes.

MCPOrgConfig.description: Org config mcp v2. Every key is optional.

MCPAdminStatus.description: mcp-admin-status-v1: an org's MCP status. enabled is the gateway's MCP switch and org_enabled the org's; each count is of the org's own servers.

MCPToolPrice.description: The published managed price of a tool call, markup included.

annotations.description: The upstream's MCP tool annotations, as sent.

MCPProbeAuth.description: A typed secret used for one probe only; never stored or logged.

MCPProbeRequest.description: POST /-/mcp/probe. A credential goes inline as auth; a body that carries credential_id is refused (400 invalid_probe_request).

MCPProbeResult.description: mcp-probe-v1. Nothing is stored. tools_hash is the sha256 of the canonical tool definitions (the form pinning uses). error names why ok is false, for example egress_refused or not_mcp.

MCPRevision.description: mcp-revision-v1: a changed, new or colliding tool definition and how it differs.

MCPApproval.description: mcp-approval-v1: an approval naming its org, virtual server, tool, argument hash, run and principal. Approvals are free.

MCPApprovalDecision.description: An approval decision: org_id is the org of the approval it decides.

MCPOAuthKeysPush.description: mcp-oauth-keys-push-v1: the public verification keys (JWK) of Django's authorization server, with their issuer and a version; never a private key.

ManagedUpstreamKey.description: A per-org managed upstream key. Push-only: never stored in an org config and never returned by a read.

upstream_keys.description: Push-only. Assembled by config_push at push time; a save that contains it is rejected with secret_in_config.

ConfigMeta.description: Push-time metadata from AgentccOrgConfig. Never stored. The gateway's policy version is "v" + version.

ToolsCapabilityConfig.description: One capability's org settings. Defaults: enabled false; providers empty (the price cards' default order); max_cost_usd_per_call unset. pinned options are developer-pinned and the model cannot override them.

ToolsPolicyConfig.description: Org capability policy. Defaults: no_training_vendors_only false, zdr_required false, no region pin, no retention override. retention_override may only tighten a card's results_retention.

ToolsConfig.description: Org config tools v1. There is no managed flag here: the managed opt-in is mcp.managed_tools. BYOK vendor credentials are providers.<vendor> entries.

IdentityIdPConfig.description: The org's identity provider for ID-JAG. client_secret is PUSH-ONLY: never stored in an org config or returned by a GET.

DelegatedGrant.description: A standing grant that lets an agent act for its grantor. PUSH-ONLY, inside identity.delegated_grants.

IdentityConfig.description: Delegated identity. require_human_sponsor defaults to false. idp.client_secret and delegated_grants are PUSH-ONLY.

delegated_grants.description: PUSH-ONLY. Active standing grants by grant id, assembled at push time; never stored in an org config.
